relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2024年12月5日付)をAppLovinが締結している
relations.text_en: AppLovin has a credit agreement dated December 5, 2024 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: AppLovin 10-K
source.quote: 10.13 Credit Agreement, dated as of December 5, 2024, by and between AppLovin Corporation, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, and the lenders party thereto.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
